prompt:
A fixed mass of gas is kept at constant volume. Its pressure $p$ is measured at four temperatures $\theta$.

| $\theta$ / °C | 0 | 20 | 40 | 60 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $p$ / kPa | 100.0 | 107.3 | 114.6 | 121.9 |

**(a)** Determine the gradient of a graph of $p$ against $\theta$. **[2]**

**(b)** Use your answer to (a) to estimate absolute zero in °C. **[2]**

**(c)** State one assumption made in the extrapolation in (b). **[1]**
markscheme:
**(a)** gradient $= \tfrac{121.9 - 100.0}{60 - 0}$ ✓ $= 0.365\ \text{kPa}\,°\text{C}^{-1}$ ✓

**(b)** At absolute zero $p = 0$: $\theta = -\tfrac{100.0}{0.365}$ ✓ $\approx -274\ °\text{C}$ ✓ (accept $-270$ to $-275$)

**(c)** The gas behaves ideally / does not liquefy down to very low temperatures / the relationship stays linear ✓
